editorial.blurb: Irazu has been serving authentic Costa Rican cuisine in Chicago since 1990, with generous portions, vibrant flavors, and a welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Go hungry and bring a friend—portions are enormous and designed to share. Ask the staff for recommendations if you're new to Costa Rican food; they're genuinely helpful in guiding your order.

topDishes.note: Costa Rica's national dish, executed beautifully
